firstPlayerRule: The player who has the most cats in real life starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The player immediately counterclockwise from the starter places the cat token during setup; the starter still takes the first turn.
